description: This Java class defines a command to enable connection logs for a specified ConnectionId within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances from JSON and for serializing the command payload.

classes.description: A command class that enables connection logging for a specific ConnectionId in the Eclipse Ditto framework.
